verdict.rationale: treg ships its own CLI. It installs via `curl … install.sh | sh`, and the docs document subcommands such as `treg review`, `treg upload clis`, `treg shell`, `treg tool ls`, `treg health` and `treg feedback submit`. A probe confirms the official CLI is documented in the tutorial. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working, and a full command reference beyond scattered examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `treg upload clis` turns the CLIs already on your machine into team tools; `treg shell` opens a shell where `stripe`, `gh`, `gcloud` … just work with the team key injected.
Discover what your team has shared: `treg tool ls` · check credential health: `treg health`.
rate that one call after using it with `treg review CALL_ID USEFULNESS [--reason "..."]`
